pr_title: Move default binding to a plugin
pr_body:
**What type of PR is this?**

/kind feature

**What this PR does / why we need it**:

Make the default binding a plugin. This removes custom logic in scheduler.go for default binding.

Add `NewFramework` to `pkg/scheduler/testing` to simplify the creation of frameworks for testing.

**Which issue(s) this PR fixes**:

Fixes #87157

**Special notes for your reviewer**:

**Does this PR introduce a user-facing change?**:

```release-note
Scheduler: Add DefaultBinder plugin
```

issue_context.title: Move the current pod binding logic into a default Bind plugin [Migration Phase 2]
issue_context.body:
The current bind logic is currently placed in generic_scheduler.go, it should move to run as Bind plugin that gets configured to execute by default.

Part of #85822
/sig scheduling
/assign @alculquicondor
comments: Should we name it `DefaultBinding` or just `Binding`?
Prefixing with ```Default``` is reasonable in this case I think.

review_comments: As discussed offline with @Huang-Wei, I'm hiding the double pointer details in this function, instead of RegisterPluginAsExtensions
I don't think it was a big deal because it was already in a local function, but this is ok as well.
